# Local MathJax 3.2.2 for CNN

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg-full.js
SHA-256: a4354ff94fd868aea0cc6eaaa79a57fda0588646fc46ee3700a349ee0a11cbe6
License: Apache-2.0; LICENSE from https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax/blob/3.2.2/LICENSE

CNN alone uses this full SVG-output bundle so equation rendering does not depend on CDN/font requests. Other chapters retain their existing MathJax setup. Do not hand-edit the minified third-party distribution.
